cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The alley's blocked. Excellent: our proposal picnic is harder to discover. Take the table by the other end.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have to use the main road. Everyone will see us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They'll see a house move. Keep the legs level; a casual removal looks more convincing than a secret procession.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your girlfriend's coming. I'll tell her to look away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. Ask her to clear a path. No secretive instructions; she's helping with a house move.

reason: Keep the public-route camouflage but have B propose a revealing concealment action. A corrects it into useful help from the proposal's recipient, celebrating the setback as a better disguise.
